reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: THIS IS THE WORST AIRLINE I HAVE EVER FLOWN!!!! My flight was canceled twice, and they did not provide any help i.e., hotel, food, or connections. The front desk did not speak enough English to help get you to your destination. I was stuck in Monterrey, Mexico overnight without a hotel and I don't speak Spanish. When we left Cabo, the front desk told us we were going to get a hotel from the airline and a food voucher. This was not the case leaving several of us stranded. I will never fly this airline again,
reviews.author: sfsfsf s

reviews.title: Zero stars. Worst airline ever!
reviews.text: Viva Air is the WORST AIRLINE IN THE WORLD. I have flown with more than 30 airlines around the world, but I never had such a nightmarish experience as I did with this airline. I bought a basic ticket for my brother or so I thought. This ticket included a backpack only. I unselected all preselected options in their website to make sure the price wouldn’t go up. I had to do this more than 8 times as the website kept adding things that I hadn’t selected. On my 8th or so attempt, I went to pay, the price was showing correctly, but on the window you have to pay, they don’t show the total price. The surprise came after I paid, The price I was charged was much higher than the original price. I also saw the ticket wasn’t for a basic flight but more for a business type of flight or M tariff as the airline calls it that included a bunch of services that I didn’t select including bags, insurance, priority boarding, seat selection, free check in at the airport, refundable ticket w/o penalty and other stuff. I was so surprised and aggravated by this and I contacted the airline right away. They never answered their phones neither in Medellin where I bought the ticket nor I’m Bogota or other cities in Colombia and much less a number I found for them in the US. I then tried to chat with them online to no avail. They wouldn’t answer my questions or they would end the chat in the middle of it or just go quiet. I was a miserable experience. I couldn’t cancel the flight because the trip was for the next day and the time didn’t allow for searching for more tickets. I was stuck with it and I never received an answer from the airline even though I wrote a detailed letter to them asking them to reimburse me for the extra costs they added to the ticket. It’s been weeks I wrote to them and I still haven’t received and answer or my money. AVOID THIS AIRLINE AT ALL COSTS!! It is ABSOLUTELY the WORST airline ever!!!
reviews.author: Juliana M

reviews.title: Still the worst airline of all time
reviews.text: Still horrible. I hate this company. I'd rather see them go out of business and pay x2 for flights for the rest of my life than to experience this airline again.
reviews.author: Sergniooooooooooooooooooo

reviews.title: Opportunistic airline
reviews.text: Cheat of an airline. I paid a lot of money for 25kg check-in allowance for two passengers. Ours bags were just 1 kg overweight and they charged us for it, whereas any other airline in the world would have made this reasonable concession. Best to avoid beggar businesses like this.
reviews.author: SiddharthMumbaiBoy

reviews.title: Ripoff
reviews.text: On 12/29/22 I booked a ticket from MED to CTG, Flight VH5636, on 2/10/23 at 1:13 PM. My flight was confirmed by eDreams. In addition to the flight for two people, I paid for two checked bags. On January 31, 2023, I received an email from Viva advising I was confirmed on a flight from MDE to CTG at 6:30AM. I went to the Viva site and rebooked for the original time and was charged $88.60. In Medellin I had the hotel check my flight and was told by Viva that because the flight was changed it was like a cancellation and the money I paid for checked baggage was lost. So, I had to pay $81.12 additional even though I had paid eDreams for the bags. Thus, this flight cost me a total of $374.51. I am owed a refund of $169.72.

reviews.title: Please believe this is actually the worst airline ever
reviews.text: Read the reviews!! Seasoned traveler and I’ve seen some bad customer service but this one takes first prize. First flight overbooked. Dismissed and treated like garbage. No recompense offered. Acted like they were doing us a favor by charging us $80 for our bags and booking us on another flight 8 hours later! They wanted us to thank them for not charging us twice. We showed up 3 hours early for a short domesticated flight. At least 20 other customers didn’t get a seat. Believe everything you read here. I never blame or get chuffed at employees for things that are out of their control or not their fault. Customer service is hard and people are mean. This companies however clearly fosters a toxic environment and culture. Rude, deliberately obsequious, just jerks. When we were finally put on a plane our seat assignment was all the way in the back next to the toilets. I have to believe this was purposeful. Terrible++
reviews.author: Daniel C

reviews.title: Delays without a reson
reviews.text: I bought my tickets almost two months before the flight. However, there were delays that cause me to arrive late to my appoinments. In this way, this service is not trustworthy.

reviews.title: Say no to Viva
reviews.text: For once, I read reviews on a business before actually making the purchase and I am so glad I did. The website for this airline adds on costs automatically so be very careful bc what you end up with will not be what you started with and you can’t make changes or contact anyone after you pay. It was the difficulty of the website and the underhanded charging that caused me to consider looking at reviews before I purchased. Another reviewer recommended Lantam or Avianca both of which are much eaiser and have actual customer service numbers. I used Lantam and am glad I did. Overall, the ticket was cheaper anyway and much less of a hassle. Beware of Viva Airlines.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Not only is the website an absolute disaster but the staff is extremely unorganized and careless. A hot hot mess. I do not recommend.

reviews.title: Terrible airline
reviews.text: Waiting to board but not only did the airline change the flight TWICE but the second time it was so unacceptable that I had to call them so that they could change the dates because it would have interfered with our tours. We had paid for everything, seats, express boarding, etc., and when I went to checkin it asked that I pay again for everything. Stupid me, I thought I would wait. Little did I know that they would charge me for not checking in. What a horrible, horrible airlines. It would have to be LANTAM or Avianca. It is definitely not worth all of the aggravation with them changing the flights and over charging. If you pick a time, it is because you have plans. An absolute terrible airline and I have yet to board it. Wonder what awaits me!!!

reviews.title: One of Worst company there is
reviews.text: Omg I saw the reviews that this company wasn’t great but it shocked me! From the recorded voices they play during the flight to everything else. It makes you want to jump out mid flight. They claim to be low cost, which baffles me, DO NOT chose it for international trips. They don’t even give you water, seats don’t even lean back, it feels like the air conditioning is off, there is nothing related to entertainment, you pay for everything, if you sneeze you will be paying a fee. Even to check in. Trust me, this is not too dramatic nor Karen like . Pay a little extra, avoid the unpleasant experience.
reviews.author: Caio P

reviews.title: Hidden fees - no email to help customers - staff unprofessional
reviews.text: First airline to never send a check in reminder. At the counter they charged me 1/2 the price of the ticket just to check in in the self check in counter. There was no line. Ive travaled to lots of places and their service is awful. No email to tell customers to check in. I just think about all the non tech customers or elderly persons who don't know they have to do it or if it's the first time you flight. Lots of sfaff and no line at all they don't do anything. they keep talking between themselves don't call us to go to their counter or don't help whatsoever. In another flight for the grandmother of my girlfriend which was in wheelchair they forgot to pick her for her flight. She lost her flight. They brand themselves as "cheap cost airline" Sure when you have lots of hidden fees and online when you book each step selects options you don't want and you have to unselect them and if you don't do it because normally no airlines work like that then you get charged. Incredible. Check the emails i receiced from them. 0 telling to check in online. At the counter they say it's written in their privacy terms. Who reads privacy terms. Right besides me they were also charging another clients those fees.
reviews.author: Juan Jose J

reviews.title: Worst airline of my life
reviews.text: If possible, avoid this airline at all costs. They are cheap but you truly get what you pay for, and then some with hidden costs. Not only do they try and upsell you 3x per each action you take making the purchasing process the worst ever, they also charge you to check in to your flight. They will automatically add on upsell options even when you don’t select them and need to go back several steps. If you can avoid doing it on mobile as it makes it even harder to avoid pop up upsells and eliminate them from your checkout. Avoid at all costs. It may be the cheapest option but after their hidden fees you may end up paying what you would for another flight. I rarely ever write reviews but this was the worst experience I’ve ever had flying on an airline and felt that I needed to warn others so they don’t go through the same BS we had to.
reviews.author: Arthur C

reviews.title: TOTAL SCAM
reviews.text: WORST AIRLINE EVER. they canceled my flight 3 times (3 days in a row) with 24 hours of advance. so I was stuck in Cali 3 extra days and missed meetings in Mexico City. I had to purchased a ticket with a different airline and Viva refused to refund me even tho I purchased the refund protection. Insurance refused to cover my expenses (insurance purchased through them). I tried to used the voucher to book flight, but the system said it was an invalid voucher. I contacted customer service and they told me I had used it already. After arguing with them for 45 minutes, they said they "canceled" some bogus booking I had and habilitated the voucher for my use again. Still refused to refunded my 555 dollars. So I tried to book a vacation flight for my wife and kid because according to the customer rep, the voucher will expired asap. My wife got to the airport to find out that her flight was canceled. This happened two days in a row and the return flight was changed to one day earlier, so she lost 2 days of hotel at the vacation spot and had to fly home a day earlier with no compensation whatsoever, DO NOT FLY WITH THIS AIRLINE
reviews.author: Timothy P

reviews.title: Double booking nightmare - do NOT fly with this airline!!
reviews.text: I booked seats in September to fly from Medellin to Santa Marta for myself, my husband and two daughters for the end of December. The flight began boarding and I got on with my daughters and sat on the plane waiting for my husband to come through. To our horror he didn’t get on. Luckily we had a family Whatsapp group and he let us know he was OK. Unbelievably, Viva Air had massively double booked the flight meaning that around 20 (yes that many!!) people didn’t get to catch this flight that they had paid for. The guy in charge basically just closed the gate, told the people left that the flight was full and walked off leaving the woman behind the desk to deal with everyone. My husband doesn’t speak Spanish but luckily another passenger helped him out and got him booked onto another flight. No apology, no compensation and costly for us as our onward travel had to be postponed. APPALLING - I wouldn’t have believed it possible if it hadn’t happened to us!!

reviews.title: Worst experience of my life even worse than my double fractured knee
reviews.text: Well here goes my first bad review ever! Booked and paid extra for seats together, data was lost. Had to pay cop 190.000 which is more than half the ticket for a carry one suitecase People from a stranded flight couple days earlier stat were still sleeping at the airport wanted to hijack the plane by trying to board out flight from Medellin to Armenia and demand a different route. We were there with small children. Management never showed up and left the poor agent to deal with the situation. Couple of us got the info to pass through the gate of a different flight and airline to board a bus and they brought us to the same plane from the outside. All the stranded people looking at us through the glass in utter anger. Kids crying. Finally 5 hours later we were on our way. At arrival transportation cars 2x charged us cop 500.000 for having to wait On way back, system for checkin down, tried couple of times but were not able. At airport we were charged cop 70.0000 each to check in at counter (7pax) because we did not bring proof (print screen) that system was down. Plane again left delayed. The started pooring bevarges 5 minutes before landing then stopped at the third row because the were landing. Maybe it was a surprise to them….. you can’t make this stuff up. 🤣🤣 Paid $150 for 45 minute flight. I will NEVER EVER EVER fly Viva air again even is Avianca would charge me $750 for that same flight! Did i say ….. EVER? Lord what a horrible experience this was!

I’m traveling with young children so this was especially difficult. The employees were not helpful and ignored me and other angry customers. What’s worse, this airline knew that my family was not going to be given seats on this flight. Our time was wasted in the airport. Do not use this horrible airline. What a terrible and stupid company.

Very high costs for every extra, including carry on or even the check in in the airport. Even if you made the web check in, you still have to spend hours in the line to get your pass. I don't understand how this airline is still in business.
reviews.author: Mario J

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: This is only my 3rd review ever but I had to write this. This is the WORST airline / airline experience I have ever flown with. I have used upwards of 30 airlines and this is the only one I would never use again, no matter how cheap it is. The customer service at the airport was completely unreasonable and enforcing rules in regards to entering other countries that are arbitrary and other companies do not enforce. We were also charged 40 dollars per ticket just to check in. Going through all their hoops and hurdles meant we went from being over 3 hours early to nearly missing our flight. Then to make matters worse, the seats were tiny and as thin as cardboard and can't be reclined. We were also given rows with no window and even less leg room than normal. Then, too make matters even worse, there were empty rows and we were told we had to pay extra to move to them! Words can't describe how bad this experience was. 0/10, would never fly again. I would rather spend 2 days on the bus than deal with this company again. Don't be sucked in. I hope no one ever flies this airline again

reviews.title: Denied boarding
reviews.text: They Denied me boarding for not having a return ticket to Europe. I did have a return flight and i showed it. Airport staff very rude and unwilling to give the traveller a positive experience.

My flight was inially set to fly at 5am and wss delayed until 9am, then 1:30pm, then 3:45pm without ant explanation or asistance from the staff. My flight was theb entirely cancelled and i have to book and pay for a different flight after 24 hours in the airport
reviews.author: Jessen

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: Omg I swear this is the most ridiculous airline ever. The people on the gate don't speak one word in English! I didn't even want them to speak I just showed them my ticket to confirm that I'm at the right gate because I could see on the screen that there was an hour difference in timing and the flight number is different, the girl just directed me to the seats against the gate and I said I will wait here right ??and I tried to make sure that this is the right flight, she kept directing me to the seats and nodding while she is lookingto my boarding pass. After I waited an hour and getting to boarding they told me I'm not at the right gate and kept saying 8 8 8 8, I ran to gate number 8 and they told me there the flight is closed ( same company same destination with an hour difference at 2 different sides of the airport!!!!! Like they can't try harder than that to confuse you) no speakers in the airport to announce or call anyone plus for sure not even someone speaks a little English even the supervisor. At the end After hectic conversations through Google translate they pushed me to buy a new ticket for the next flight in 12 hours. Stuck in the airport, paid more because they don't even look carefully on the ticket!!!!!!

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.text: The airline does not know how to provide service to travel and enjoy the flight. It is a airline for people who does know what is enjoy a trip. The personal is not professional and the pilot does not have enough experience. The landings are hard and scary. My recommendation don’t risk your life traveling with this airline.
reviews.author: Catherine F

reviews.title: RUN AWAY! CROOKS, DISHONEST COMPANY
reviews.text: TERRIBLE EXPÉRIENCE! RUN AWAY We were flying from Buenos Aires to Bogotá. When we arrived at the counter to drop our checked luggage, the staff refused my girlfriend's luggage, even though we paid for both. Even though I showed them the proof of payment, purchase summary and booking details, which were all attesting that we had 2 checked luggage of 20kg, they refused it. We had to deal with two arrogant, disrespectful employees that dit not seem to be willing to help us but to rather make us pay an additional luggage, which was 2x the price (USD100). They pretended to handle the situation, put us aside the counter and continued to deal with other passengers, leaving us without any help or update. I had to harass both of the employees to get their attention and to find a solution. Even though I did not make anything wrong, they kept ignoring the proofs we provided them. After 2 hours waiting for a solution, all passengers completed their check-in, and we were the only ones left. Our boarding was about to start, while we were stuck at the counter, which was about to close. Then, one of the employees told us to drop our luggage on the treadmill, that it was okay, without any explanation our apologies (the problem was one their side for the whole time). We had to run through the controls, adding some stress and nervousness to our trip. I cannot say how bad I hate this company which tried to make us pay an additional luggage for no reason, which tries to profit from you and to scam you, saying that they do not see any luggage or so from their side. The way they treat you is so arrogant, disrespectful and careless. I knew this company had a very poor rating, but I didn’t expect them to go this far with their customers! So if I had one advice for you: RUN AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY!
reviews.author: Gilles G

reviews.title: Great Flight, Delayed Luggage, No Accountability
reviews.text: Viva forgot our checked baggage in Cusco and we were without our clothes, hygiene products and medication for 24 hours. They kept promising to deliver the luggage, but then delayed and delayed. When it finally arrived, we had spent a whole day stuck in our Airbnb waiting, missing out on excursions we had already paid for. We assumed that the ariline would at least compensate us for the supplies we were missing, but they are willing to do nothing. There customer service line is just an email address that can take up to 15 days to get back to you and have been terribly unhelpful. I would never book with this airline again.
reviews.author: Thetweedswede

reviews.title: Avoid This Airline
reviews.text: I booked a flight from Pereira to Santa Marta via Bogota on October 16th. When I arrived at airport for flight on Novemer 21, I noticed my 2nd flight was boarding over 2 hours past when we should have arrived at our final destination. I showed the original itinerary to the employee. He was completely useless. Not only did the airline completely change the route of the 2nd flight without any advance notice, the flight arrived over 5 hours late. We had to drive to Tayrona National Park in the dark and were completely exhausted for our day of hiking the next day because we got there so late. Might be the worst experience I've ever had with an airline. And the weather conditions were just fine the whole day.

Now my flight back has 25 HOURS OF STOPOVER. INSANE. It was 3 hours when i boought it. Do not buy any tickets with this airline. It is not worth it for yor mental health. reviews.title: If you're used to RyainAir/Easyjet... it's the same
reviews.text: I read so many bad reviews, I ended up buying the full package and the flights were all fine and on time. I use Easyjet and Ryanair all the time and this airline uses the exact same policies and charges, so if you're used to using the above, it's more or less the same. I did book my flights months in advance, and they did change the time and I had to sort some stuff out, but I used the what's app function, it took them about 8 hours to respond, but with they did, sorted it all out.

Absolutely TERRIBLE service and I will NEVER use this airline again. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

reviews.title: DO NOT USE THIS AIRLINE - Awful Experience
reviews.text: Got to the check in desk to find out they had not booked me on the flight despite sending me confirmation emails and documents. Then said I had to pay an absolute fortune or I would not be able to get on the plane. Staff did not help in any sort of way or offer any compensation. They were rude but did admit that the airline was terrible. Another time they charged me £90 to bring my hand luggage onto the plane as their website was not working and I could not add one on there. Only airline I have ever been on where you need to pay for hand luggage. They are borderline scammers. Never seen any airline like this in my life. Please don’t use, very likely they will catch you out.
reviews.author: Tom W

reviews.title: Bad - Worse - Viva Air
reviews.text: We wanted to check-in online for our flight from Cusco - Lima but (what a surprise) it didn‘t work due to their homepage. So when we got to the airport and were told that we have to pay 60€ because we didn‘t do the online check-in we tried to explain that it wasn‘t our fault and that we even wrote an e-mail to the customer support and never got an answer. The (not so friendly) lady only spoke spanish and couldn‘t understand our problem and when we finally talked to an (friendly) Viva employee who speaks english, he wanted to see the e-mail and checked us in without paying (thank you to that guy!). Viva Air also sits families/pairs on purpose not next to each other so when you enter the airplane, they say that you can buy seats next to each other. For us it is the worst airline ever and we will never fly with them again! Wouldn‘t recommend to anyone, it is not worth the money and the nerves!!

reviews.title: It's such a venereous disease, an STD of an airline.
reviews.text: It should be avoided at all costs, it robs you and it makes you lose your time. Don't book flights with Colombian airlines using Expedia or any other booking agent.
reviews.author: Carlos R
